# Frame Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:FrameKind`](gmeow-FrameKind.md)

The structural type of a reference frame (e.g. geodetic, Cartesian, polar, grid, narrative).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:FrameKind`](gmeow-FrameKind.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the structural type of a reference frame (geodetic, Cartesian, polar, grid, narrative) as a value individual.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the kind as a [`ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) subclass ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint the kind as a [`gmeow:FrameKind`](gmeow-FrameKind.md) individual and reference it from a frame via the functional [`gmeow:frameKind`](../properties/gmeow-frameKind.md).
